# StorefrontBot

> StorefrontBot is a web-based WhatsApp assistant for businesses. It helps customers make appointment bookings and ask about product stock, while business owners manage bookings, stock and available time slots through a dashboard.

## Website
- Homepage: https://storefrontbot.onrender.com/
- How it works: https://storefrontbot.onrender.com/#how
- Features: https://storefrontbot.onrender.com/#features
- Frequently asked questions: https://storefrontbot.onrender.com/#faq

## Public policies
- Privacy policy: https://storefrontbot.onrender.com/chatbot/privacy/
- Data deletion instructions: https://storefrontbot.onrender.com/chatbot/data-deletion/

## Product scope
- Customer conversations take place through WhatsApp.
- The public website describes appointment booking, booking cancellation, stock enquiries and a business owner dashboard.
- Service availability, prices and appointment times are configured by each business.
- StorefrontBot is a web application; customers do not need a separate customer app to message a business.

## Guidance
- Use the privacy policy for information about personal data handling and service providers.
- Do not assume that every business using StorefrontBot offers the same services, prices, location or opening hours.
- Do not invent pricing, customer reviews, certifications, integrations or service guarantees that are not stated on the website.
